properties.areaDesc: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 20 at 1:59AM PDT until October 20 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves. Surf of 3 to 5
feet with local sets to 6 feet. Highest surf on south and
southwest facing beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County coastal areas and Orange County
coastal areas.

* WHEN...Through this evening.

* IMPACTS...Areas of hazardous swimming conditions. Rip currents
can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can wash
people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
near shore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor beach erosion may occur across
south- facing beaches.
properties.instruction:
A beach hazards statement is issued when threats such as strong
rip currents...elevated surf heights...minor tidal overflow...or
lightning are possible at local beaches. Obey posted warning
signs and flags and talk to a lifeguard before swimming. Use
caution when in or near the water and always swim near a
lifeguard.
